description: Cross-sectional opportunity scan across every major and medium-cap coin at once — the screener the per-coin tools cannot be looped into safely. Two whole-universe feeds (the merged market snapshot + venue perp contexts) build a liquidity-filtered universe and rank it, then candles are fetched for a bounded shortlist only; ZERO per-symbol calls are made to the rate-limited derivatives provider, which is what lets this cover a universe without silently degrading. Up to eight signals per candidate: crowding (annualized funding vs the venue-standard anchor AND its percentile across the screened universe right now — a cross-sectional read, explicitly NOT the own-history percentile research_positioning reports; reported without a vote, because funding extremes have tended to continue rather than reverse), stress (24h long and short liquidations each as a share of open interest, both read on Bybit so the ratio is one book — longs flushed leans long, shorts flushed (a spent squeeze) leans short), leverage (open interest as a share of market cap — the gap-through-your-stop condition), compression (4h Bollinger bandwidth ranked against the coin's own trailing window — the per-coin form of the reading research_regime computes for BTC alone; says energy is loading, never direction), trend (ADX with the +DI/-DI separation on 4h, confirmed against 1d — votes +1 only for a strong 3:1 trend the slow timeframe agrees with), location (distance from the 4h EMA20 in ATR units — an extended coin scores DOWN, because a chase is not a setup), entry (whether the limit is still live) and reward (net-of-fees reward:risk and stop distance). Each signal reports its state, the numbers, and a +1/0/-1 setup-quality vote; the setup name and score come from a disclosed rule shipped with every scan, under which the reading that named the setup counts 0. Each candidate also says why it is worth a look now: its 24h price, OI (venue contracts) and volume against its own last 60 days, the plain-word labels those earn (longs building, short covering, crowded short, coiling, ...), and for each label what followed it in a 2-year backtest, verdict included (often 'no edge'). Priced setups carry their setup type's backtest track record (trades, win rate, average R after fees, against random entries). Each candidate says whether it is ACTIONABLE (a priced live entry, net reward:risk >= 1.5, score >= +1) and, when not, which gates it missed; actionable candidates rank first. Candidates carry ATR-and-structure trade plans priced so they feed research_trade_plan directly. A TRENDING PULLBACK is entered at market with its levels from the EMA20 pullback, taking half at +1R and moving the rest to breakeven (60% of 19,139 backtested trades won, about 0R on average, the same as random entries with those exits); an ABSORPTION SHORT (yesterday's Binance taker-buy share in the bottom 10% of the coin's own 60 days while the day closed flat or up) is a short at market, stop 2.5 ATR, target 2R, the one setup type that beat random entries in the backtest; a BREAKDOWN (24h drop in the bottom 5% of the coin's own 60 days) is a short at market; a COIL BREAKOUT (volatility squeezed, no trend) is a stop bracket around the 10-candle range. Stops sit behind the recent swing (a bracket's at the range midpoint), and targets at the structural level or 2R, whichever is nearer. Every priced plan carries its type's 2-year backtest record and a plain caveat; none of the three types passed a pre-registered edge test. No geometry is priced after a 24h move beyond ±30% or with a stop over 15% from entry; the candidate says why. Tokenized gold (XAUT, PAXG) is not screened, and one coin listed under two venue tickers (e.g. PUMP and PUMPFUN) is screened once. 'tier' filters major/medium/all; 'limit' caps the ranked list; 'symbols' narrows the universe to specific coins, and every symbol named there is accounted for individually in the response — selected, excluded by your own tier filter, below the liquidity floors (never screened, so no band was ever applied to it), below the tier floor, or not quoted at all — because mere absence from the ranked list conflates four different answers. Reports a board, not a forecast: the bands are disclosed constants chosen for plausibility with no backtest behind them, and 'NO CANDIDATES' is a real and frequent answer. Use it to pick what to look at, then research_positioning and ta_technicals on the two or three that stand out.

intervals.description: The timeframe pair to analyse, FINEST FIRST: [fast] or [fast, slow]. Default ["4h","1d"]. This is the most consequential argument: entry, stop, target, ATR and every AT STRUCTURE verdict are measured on the fast timeframe, so changing it produces a DIFFERENT trade rather than a refinement of the same one — on one live BTC read the 1h pair put the entry 0.2% above spot while the 1d pair put it 10.7% below, with stops of 0.77% and 3.31%. Lookbacks are counted in candles, so the swing windows scale too (30 candles is 5 days at 4h, 7 hours at 15m). The second interval only CONFIRMS the first and must be slower; pass one interval to skip confirmation, which halves the candle cost and makes the trend vote abstain.

limit.description: Ranked candidates to return. Default 10, max 25.

symbols.description: Optional: narrow the universe to these coin symbols, e.g. ["SOL","AVAX"]. Omit to screen everything that clears the tier and liquidity floors.

tier.description: Size tier to screen: 'major' (market cap >= $10B), 'medium' ($300M-$10B), or 'all' (default).

name: research_opportunities

absorptionToday.description: How many selected coins fired the ABSORPTION SHORT reading on the last closed UTC day. Descriptive only: the setup's backtested result came mostly from days it fired on many coins at once. Null when the reading was not taken (a fast interval other than 4h).

read.description: Coins whose taker flow answered and could be ranked

evidence.description: passed | failed | none: whether this setup type passed its pre-registered backtest (beat random entries in both years after fees and funding). Only ABSORPTION SHORT passed; read a 'failed' plan as a described setup, not an edge. none = EXTENDED or NO SETUP, which carry no plan.

geometry.description: ATR-and-structure prices, ready for research_trade_plan. Absent for EXTENDED and NO SETUP, and whenever a plan was refused a price (see notPriced).

bracket.description: Both legs of a stop bracket: the first to trade fills and cancels the other

breakEvenWinRatePct.description: Win rate at which the setup breaks even net of those fees, in percent; null when a win doesn't cover its fees

entryGapAtr.description: How far live price sits from the entry in ATR units, signed in the setup's favour: positive means the limit has not been reached yet, negative that price has passed it

entryUsd.description: Where the entry is placed, per orderType: the 4h EMA20 for a limit, the live price for market, the buy-stop for a stop bracket (see bracket for both legs)

freshness.description: PENDING (limit not reached) | AT ENTRY (filling now) | THROUGH (passed the limit, stop still holds). Geometry is absent entirely when INVALIDATED — price is already at or beyond the stop.

livePriceUsd.description: The live merged market price the entry was checked against

management.description: Post-fill management the plan was backtested with: take partialFraction at partialAtR from the fill, then move the stop on the rest to breakeven

netRewardRisk.description: Reward:risk net of base-tier fees (Binance: maker entry and target, taker stop). What the geometry pays; research_trade_plan adds carry and slippage.

rewardRisk.description: Reported as computed, never adjusted to clear the 2:1 bar

stopDistancePct.description: Stop distance as a percentage of entry

targetBasis.description: The structural level the target was shaded inside, named

targetDistanceAtr.description: Target distance in ATR(14) units. Read alongside rewardRisk: a tight stop with a distant target prices well and still asks price to travel a long way. R:R is geometry, never expectancy.

lean.description: long, short, or empty. A lean, never a call; a COIL BREAKOUT carries none until a leg of its bracket fills.

setup.description: ABSORPTION SHORT (short at market) | TRENDING PULLBACK (at market, half at +1R) | BREAKDOWN (short at market) | COIL BREAKOUT (stop bracket) | EXTENDED | NO SETUP. EXTENDED is reported so it is NOT taken as an entry.

contribution.description: What the signal contributed to the score once the setup's side was known. Equals vote except where the signal leans against that side, when the sign flips — a reading favouring the opposite side is evidence the entry would be joining the cohort that pays.

detail.description: The numbers behind the state, as prose

metrics.description: The same numbers keyed by metric name, e.g. fundingUniversePercentile, bandwidthOwnPercentile, distanceFromEma20Atr

vote.description: The signal's own reading: +1 supports a defined entry, -1 argues against one, 0 informational. Not summable with research_regime or research_positioning votes.

tierFromVolume.description: True when no market-cap source answered and the tier was inferred from 24h volume instead — a weaker claim than a size tier, and those rows carry no leverage signal

timeframes.description: Intervals whose candles answered; empty means Stage A signals only

caveats.description: What the scan cannot see, stated rather than implied

coverage.description: What the scan actually looked at — read this before treating an empty candidate list as a quiet market

fastInterval.description: The timeframe every level in this report is measured on

perpCovered.description: Coins with a venue perp context, the source of the 24h volume floor

priceDisagreements.description: Shortlisted coins whose candle series was DISCARDED because its newest close disagreed with the merged market price beyond the divergence band — a stale or mismatched series (e.g. a delisted pair a venue still serves). A wrong answer, not a missing one. These candidates carry Stage A signals only and are never priced.

quoted.description: Coins the merged market feed returned with a usable price

screened.description: Every coin passing the liquidity floors — the universe every cross-sectional percentile is computed against, whatever tier or symbols were requested

selected.description: Coins left after the tier/symbol narrowing — the set the shortlist is drawn from. Equal to screened when nothing was filtered.

slowInterval.description: The confirmation timeframe; absent when only one interval was requested, in which case the trend vote abstains

technicalsFailed.description: Shortlisted coins whose candles did not answer; their candidates carry Stage A signals only

requestedSymbols.description: One entry per symbol named in the 'symbols' argument, so a symbol missing from 'candidates' can be explained. Empty when no symbols were named. A status other than 'selected' means no band was applied to that coin, so its absence says nothing about its setup.

detail.description: The numbers behind the status, with the floor each was measured against

status.description: selected | tier_excluded | below_liquidity_floors | below_tier_floor | not_quoted | excluded | alias

rule.description: The exact rule that produced setup and score

title: Opportunity Scan
